publication_surface.identifier: Official Journal references of harmonised standards supporting Directive 2006/42/EC
publication_surface.authenticity_basis: Directive 2006/42/EC Article 7(2) links publication of a harmonised-standard reference in the Official Journal to presumption of conformity with the corresponding essential health and safety requirements.

dependencies.condition_statement: Presumption of conformity under Directive 2006/42/EC Article 7(2) depends on conformity with a harmonised standard whose reference has been published in the Official Journal, subject to any published restriction.

scope.statement: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/80 maintains the OJ reference to EN 50434:2014 with a restriction: for machines whose shredding means can rotate above 300 r/min, the standard does not confer presumption of conformity with Annex I points 1.1.2(a) and 1.3.3 of Directive 2006/42/EC.

source_refs.locator: Article 1 and Annex row 622a — maintained OJ reference with restriction
Article 2 — entry into force on 13 January 2026

forbidden_inferences: The restriction withdraws the entire OJ reference to EN 50434:2014.
EN 50434:2014 provides no presumption of conformity for machines outside the stated restricted scope.
Lack of presumption for the specified requirements and machines means use of the standard is prohibited or that no alternative conformity route exists.
Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/80 is a textual amendment of Directive 2006/42/EC Article 7(2).
notes: Candidate-B frozen #411 restriction case. It tests partial loss of presumption while OJ citation remains.
